[[File:Keren_map.png|thumb|A map showing the Government Education Center]]
The '''Government Education Center''' was a governmental area located within the central [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], the second largest settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The center housed the [[City Government Complex]] and bordered the [[Marina District/Legends|Marina District]] and the residential areas, while facing [[Lake Varum]].
